beats.say: That update you keep postponing might be fixing a hole in your phone.
Software always has bugs, and some of them let attackers in. Updates close those doors.
Updates also bring new features and fix things that were annoying you.
The easy way is to turn on automatic updates in your phone settings.
Plug in overnight, and your phone updates while you sleep.
Switch it on now, and remind a family member who never updates.
